public_anchor.text: 1. Schedule exit interview 5 business days before the employee's last day.

obligations.why_not_expressible: Calendar path expressed: start date (UTC) = add_business_days(Last Day, -5, holidays) with both weekend readings accepted, ASAP window when the target has passed, and a guard join against other future-dated events for the same employee. Email path (the only listed tool is Gmail): a computed date cannot be mentioned (MentionTerm has no date mode; a derived calendar_date is predicate_mentions_value_unavailable, R4-L2), so an email invite leaves the date unknown (correct_email_invites_only abstains).
obligations.mechanism_sketch: mentions mode 'date' taking a derived calendar_date and reading ISO (2026-04-20), 'April 20, 2026', 'Apr 20', 'Monday, April 20'; numeric d/m forms unknown; a year-less form matches only within the declared year.

decisions.holidays: 2026 US federal holidays declared explicitly; none falls in 2026-04-08..2026-05-15, so targets equal the weekend-only reading on this data.
decisions.weekend_last_day: Reading A counts back from the last day (Karen 04-20, Nathan 04-27); reading B from the last working day (04-17, 04-24). Both accepted; they coincide for weekday last days (Rosa 05-08).
decisions.target_passed: Olivia's target 04-13 precedes the 04-15 clock: any date from today to before her last day (04-15..04-17) is accepted; a past-date event is not.
decisions.duplicates: Another created event for the same employee on a different not-yet-passed date makes the date check 0 (game_many_dates_for_karen); a superseded past-date event does not (Luna's Olivia).

mechanism_defects.mechanism: manifest scoring runtime (not a manifest operator)
mechanism_defects.code: manifest_assessments.py:156 assessment_requests / :230 manifest_check / :269 plan_credit call contracts.loader.load_contract and canonical_contract_digest per assessment
mechanism_defects.observed: one Luna scoring pass of the 16-check break draft: 43 s, of which load_contract 197 calls (16.4 s), canonical_contract_digest 696 calls (6.8 s), parse_predicate 7108 calls (8.3 s)
mechanism_defects.effect: Scoring cost grows with (checks x requests x manifest size); a 16-check manifest takes ~45 s per pass, ~2.5 min per scored alternative (score + rescore + reload). This throttles RL reward throughput, not correctness.
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Cache the admitted ContractSpec and its canonical digest per (task, manifest bytes) for the duration of one score() call; reuse parsed predicates.
